title: Marked Cartesian mapping-simplex prism extension
statement: Use small simplicial sets and standard simplices as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], cartesian fibrations and natural markings as in [lem-coef-relative-marked-anodyne-calculus], minimal and full markings as in [lem-coef-marked-anodyne-lifting-calculus], and the Kan model structure of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Let $n\geq0$, let $p:Y\to\Delta^n$ be a small cartesian fibration, put $Y_n=p^{-1}(n)$, and let $s:A^\flat\times(\Delta^n)^\sharp\to Y^\natural$ be a marked map over $\Delta^n$. Suppose its final-fiber map has a factorization $A\xrightarrow{j}A_n\xrightarrow{h}Y_n$, with $j$ a monomorphism and $h$ a trivial Kan fibration. There is a marked map $\widetilde s:A_n^\flat\times(\Delta^n)^\sharp\to Y^\natural$ over $\Delta^n$ satisfying $\widetilde s\circ(j\times1)=s$ and $\widetilde s|_{A_n\times\{n\}}=h$.
